title: Pure tensors detect maps to internal Hom
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:A\to B$ a ring map, and $F$ a functor on the one-object module-sheaf sites with objects equal to the specified scalar extensions [def-pc-perfect-rhom-base-change-map]. For $A$-module sheaves $T,M$, a $B$-module sheaf $N$, and maps $f,g:F(T)\to\mathcal Hom_B(F(M),N)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], suppose at every site object $U$ and for all $b,c\in B$, $x\in T(U)$ and $y\in M(U)$, the evaluations at the identity slice object satisfy $f(b\otimes x)(c\otimes y)=g(b\otimes x)(c\otimes y)$. Then $f=g$.

proof.text: The bottom-topology sheafification unit is invertible. Its objectwise bijectivity, followed by the object equality for F, transports TensorProduct.induction_on to induction on extended sections, with zero, sum and pure-tensor cases.

Apply sectionwise extensionality. In the pure-tensor case, apply internal-Hom morphism extensionality over the slice. Every slice object is equal to the identity object, since the site is Discrete PUnit. Induct on the argument in F(M); the pure-tensor case is the hypothesis, and zero and addition follow from linearity.

theorem ringExtension_internalHom_ext
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    (F : RingSiteModules A ⥤ RingSiteModules B)
    (hF : ∀ M, F.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings (ringSiteMap φ) M)
    (T M : RingSiteModules A) (N : RingSiteModules B)
    (f g : F.obj T ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf B)
      (F.obj M) N)
    (h : ∀ (U : (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1})ᵒᵖ) (b c : B)
      (x : T.val.obj U) (y : M.val.obj U),
      ((f.val.app U (ringExtensionPure φ F hF T U b x)).app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U.unop)))) (ringExtensionPure φ F hF M U c y) =
      ((g.val.app U (ringExtensionPure φ F hF T U b x)).app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U.unop)))) (ringExtensionPure φ F hF M U c y)) : f = g
